scope: Semantic audit of Tracer development model; not product conformance or user validation

fields.title: Local configurable engineering model
fields.statement: Authors can define typed records and directed relationships in a persistent local project without an account.
fields.acceptance: Define a custom model, author and connect records, reopen the same database and retain identities and data.
fields.remaining: Representative-user validation and broader backend/team portability remain separate.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Decompose into model establishment, schema semantics, record/link authoring and persistence obligations; start with the pilot

fields.title: Guarded contextual authoring
fields.statement: Authors can create/edit records and relationships with schema/version guards and retained in-session proposals.
fields.acceptance: A confirmed save persists; stale saves conflict; unchanged edits create no revision; other pending fields survive a single-field save.
fields.remaining: Bulk paste/mutation and portable unsaved drafts are excluded.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Separate confirmed save, conflict handling, no-op edits and draft retention; retain shared invariants through explicit links

fields.title: Connected navigation across representations
fields.statement: Engineers can inspect connected records through the shared Graph, Matrix and History workspace while retaining context.
fields.acceptance: Follow connected items, switch representations and return with canonical identity, selection and bounded scope explained.
fields.remaining: Larger-dataset usability and richer temporal comparison need further work.
fields.statusBasis: Overall implementation remains documentation-based. WORK-009 graph-card overflow correction is verified by scoped file artifacts and an immutable receipt; other TR-003 behavior has not received a complete requirement-to-code audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Separate navigation/identity, context preservation and presentation constraints; map the scoped card correction

fields.title: Separate actionable work queues
fields.statement: Engineers can distinguish missing statements, zero-target allocations/plans, changed inputs and unresolved reviews.
fields.acceptance: Each queue has complete bounded counts and direct actions; missing configuration or read failure cannot appear as zero work.
fields.remaining: Assignment, linked follow-ups, closure criteria and user validation remain separate.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Specify common completeness/failure semantics and each queue's applicability; avoid one badge for five distinct obligations

fields.title: Evidence reassessment and recorded judgment
fields.statement: Reviewers can inspect immutable results, compare declared inputs and record a version-scoped judgment.
fields.acceptance: Changed/unknown inputs and technical outcomes remain distinct; decisions preserve original receipts and do not clear drift.
fields.remaining: Organizational approval authority and representative reviewer validation remain absent.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Separate immutable result, input comparison and judgment semantics; keep their interaction acceptance

fields.title: History, baselines and change investigation
fields.statement: Engineers can inspect history and scoped baseline comparisons while preserving recorded identities and evidence.
fields.acceptance: Inspect exact earlier native states and explain the bounded relationships used in change investigation.
fields.remaining: Arbitrary two-revision comparison, complete project diff/restoration and general proposed-change review remain open.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Separate history, baseline reconstruction, comparison and proposed-change investigation; restoration stays a separately selected future scope

fields.title: Create-only CSV import
fields.statement: Authors can map CSV columns to a model, resolve exact keys, preview all errors and atomically create records/links.
fields.acceptance: Any invalid row blocks the batch; intervening changes require a fresh preview; existing records are not overwritten.
fields.remaining: Workbook import, overwrite/merge, saved mapping recipes and receipt import are excluded.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Retain as a capability grouping; specify mapping, identity resolution, validation, concurrency and atomic commit criteria

fields.title: Deterministic recorded-project export
fields.statement: Users and agents can export current native data, recorded history and evidence references with exact versions and provenance.
fields.acceptance: An unchanged database exports identical JSON bytes; preparation is read-only; external contents are explicitly excluded.
fields.remaining: Restore, selected-baseline packages and human-readable review packages remain separate.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Retain bounded export behavior; split deterministic content, read-only preparation and external-content boundaries where independently assessed

fields.title: Useful persistent Engineering starter
fields.statement: New users can start with an editable engineering model, structural policies and optional named Matrix recipes.
fields.acceptance: First setup saves atomically; reopening retains model/data/views and never reseeds an existing project.
fields.remaining: The starter is optional; no representative-user usefulness claim.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Separate first-save/reopen behavior from the usefulness hypothesis; keep optional templates and policies explicit

fields.title: Headless application access
fields.statement: Programs can query and mutate the same project through the public service, CLI and typed local HTTP API.
fields.acceptance: Operate without frontend assets; shared validation and project selection apply; uncertain writes are not automatically retried.
fields.remaining: Local interface only; authentication, hosted integration and MCP remain future work.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.
fields.scopeNote: Bounded summary; follow linked source for exact semantics. Extensions require selection.

requirements.proposedDisposition: Identify service/CLI/HTTP parity and applicable differences; do not treat interfaces as three independent products

fields.title: Recover uncertain changeset outcomes
fields.statement: Clients can identify a committed changeset by a stable command identity and avoid duplicate mutation.
fields.acceptance: Resolve the original committed outcome; changed payloads cannot silently reuse a command identity.
fields.remaining: Documentation reports implementation; audit the current uncommitted changes before stronger verification claims.
fields.statusBasis: Imported documentation assessment on 2026-10-20; no fresh implementation audit.

fields.acceptance: Required incompatible or unavailable capabilities block configured client writes; stale checks cannot restore readiness.
fields.remaining: Documentation reports implementation; no authenticated server or exhaustive semantic schema implied.
